items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I had the band out there with Max the Mayor... he gave me the band and he let me have the checkroom.

ctx.x: triplets, you know, thirds, and, you know what I mean, things like that, and tremolo. But the show closed, and it later became a movie, but I don't think that that movie carried the theme which would have been, you know...maybe they perhaps could have used a clarinet to play, you know what I mean crescendoes and all that business.

But the show closed, and after that I went to 52nd Street, and I went back to the Café Society. And then we opened a place in Brooklyn and I had the band out there with Max the Mayor. Do you know Max the Mayor? He didn't understand the quart system. He didn't understand...I had to show him and his partner how to take an inventory on their whiskey. You know, they just...you know, the bartender just poured like that they didn't know the difference... and then/they didn't know what was left...they'd just take all…

Now in exchange for me doing that, what I did for him to help him, he gave me the band and he let me have the checkroom. Well, I was always all right with...these people were supposed to be underworld people, or gangsters, or whatever they were...I didn't know. But I always...I could get checkrooms. You know, so this is how I'm making a living.
